shellCommands.command: for f in /workspace/app/layout.tsx /workspace/app/page.tsx /workspace/app/product/page.tsx /workspace/lib/data.ts /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done

find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html' | head; echo "--- shell contents ---"; for f in $(find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html'); do echo "== $f"; grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Loading availability\|in stock\|Price:' "$f" | sort -u; done

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "=== first byte timing ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/p1.html -w 'ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s total=%{time_total}s\n' http://localhost:3111/product; echo "=== streamed doc contains ==="; grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Loading availability\|in stock' /tmp/p1.html | sort -u; echo "=== freshness across 2 requests ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '[0-9]* in stock'; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '[0-9]* in stock'

grep -o '.\{80\}in stock' /tmp/p1.html; echo "=== req A ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '.\{60\}in stock'; echo "=== req B ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '.\{60\}in stock'

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; (npx next dev -p 3112 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &); sleep 8; curl -s http://localhost:3112/ > /dev/null; curl -s http://localhost:3112/product > /dev/null; sleep 4; echo "=== dev log ==="; grep -iE "instant|error|warn|blocking|suspense|shell" /tmp/dev.log | head -30; echo "=== (end) ==="; pkill -f "next dev"

setsid nohup npx next dev -p 3113 > /tmp/dev2.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & sleep 9; curl -s http://localhost:3113/product > /dev/null; curl -s http://localhost:3113/ > /dev/null; sleep 4; grep -iE "instant|blocking|suspense|shell|error|warn" /tmp/dev2.log | head -30; echo "=== full tail ==="; tail -15 /tmp/dev2.log
pkill -f "next dev"; cat AGENTS.md; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short
cat /workspace/AGENTS.md; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short && git diff --stat
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "=== my diff ==="; git diff app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts
